name: @layera-labs/orbit-brand
//private: The brand itself, not a thing a consumer mounts. Publishing it would invite someone to build an interface that looks like Orbit's, which is the one thing a white-label SDK must not hand out. The SDK's own themeable surface is @layera-labs/orbit-ui.
description: Orbit's brand primitives: the Plate mark, the icon set, the display face, and the tokens that must not diverge between products
author: Layera Labs
//exports: Source, not dist. Every consumer is a Next app inside this workspace that already transpiles workspace packages, so a build step here would buy nothing and cost a watch process during development.
